static_trace: _initialize_population adds every new expression to evaluated_expressions
evolve selects fitness-is-None members for evaluation
parallel_evaluate_fitness removes every expression already in evaluated_expressions
findings.measured_consequence: all N random initial candidates are filtered from the evaluator; their fitness is then set to -infinity. Supplied seed programs follow the same pre-mark path.
findings.uncertainty: static path inspection; the third-party package was deliberately not executed

findings.static_trace: _save_to_initial_population receives rpn but never appends or serializes it; it moves the prior file to .bak and pickles an empty list
findings.measured_consequence: every threshold-qualified save produces an empty active seed file, so the advertised evolutionary memory cannot seed the next run

findings.static_trace: DIV declares its output unit as x*y rather than x/y
findings.measured_consequence: dimension validation can reject a valid ratio or certify the wrong dimensional identity before BRAIN evaluates it
findings.uncertainty: the downstream frequency on generated trees is unmeasured

findings.static_trace: load_tested_expressions and filter_untested deduplicate on expression alone although each payload carries simulation settings
findings.measured_consequence: the same construction under a different universe, delay, neutralization or other setting is silently treated as already tested
findings.uncertainty: frequency depends on the user's configuration population

findings.static_trace: _resolve_group iterates zip(group, children) without asserting equal cardinality
findings.measured_consequence: if the API returns fewer child IDs than submitted payloads, the unmatched tail has no outcome row and disappears from every denominator
findings.uncertainty: the public source supplies no observed child-shortfall rate

findings.static_trace: batch group-submit failures append rows to in-memory results but not pending_save; only pending_save is flushed to SQLite/CSV
findings.measured_consequence: failed submitted cells can appear in the terminal report yet be absent from the durable trial ledger
findings.uncertainty: the number lost per run equals the payloads in failed batch submissions

findings.static_trace: single mode returns immediately after three consecutive errors without emitting typed rows for the unattempted remainder
findings.measured_consequence: a preregistered population is censored by submission order unless the remainder is explicitly conserved as deferred/unattempted
findings.uncertainty: batch mode follows a different path and does not use this breaker
